en.title: Brad Pitt's Cliff Booth Returns: First Trailer Drops for Tarantino/Fincher Film
en.summary: The wait is over! Brad Pitt is back as Cliff Booth in the first teaser trailer for 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth.' The highly anticipated Once Upon a Time in Hollywood spin-off is officially on its way.
en.body:
The roar of Led Zeppelin's "Black Dog" signals the return of one of cinema's coolest, deadliest stuntmen. **Brad Pitt** is back as **Cliff Booth** in the first official teaser trailer for **The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth**, a highly anticipated spin-off from Quentin Tarantino's **Once Upon a Time in Hollywood**. Directed by the master of mood and meticulous detail, **David Fincher**, and penned by **Quentin Tarantino** himself, the film promises a wild ride through the underbelly of 1977 Los Angeles.

The teaser, released online after a limited theatrical run, offers a tantalizing glimpse of what awaits. We see Pitt reprising his Oscar-winning role, exuding that signature effortless swagger. The trailer hints at a narrative steeped in murder, blackmail, theft, and extortion – "just another summer in Hollywood," as the newly expanded synopsis puts it. This isn't the sun-drenched, nostalgic 1969 of the original film; the fairytale is over, and the stakes are clearly higher.

## A Fincher-Tarantino Collaboration Unveiled

This project marks a significant collaboration, bringing together two auteurs with distinct yet complementary styles. Fincher, known for his dark, atmospheric thrillers like **Se7en** and **Zodiac**, seems to lend a gritty, suspenseful tone, while Tarantino's trademark razor-sharp dialogue and penchant for revisionist history are evident. The trailer showcases a rapid-fire montage of scenes featuring a star-studded cast, including **Carla Gugino**, **Yahya Abdul-Mateen II**, **Elizabeth Debicki**, **Scott Caan**, and **Emily Alyn Lind**. The visual style appears to be pure Fincher, while the dialogue crackles with Tarantino's unmistakable wit and edge.

Fans have been tracking this project since its inception, eager to see how Tarantino and Fincher would interpret the character of Cliff Booth beyond his pivotal role in **Once Upon a Time in Hollywood**. The film is set eight years after Booth's encounter with the Manson Family, placing it squarely in the decadent and dangerous era of late 70s Los Angeles. The title itself, **The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth**, suggests a continuation of the character's often perilous journey, exploring new exploits that push him to his limits.

## What Fans Can Expect

The immediate reaction online has been one of overwhelming excitement. The combination of Pitt, Tarantino, and Fincher is a dream team for cinephiles and fans of the original film. The trailer's dark, suspenseful tone, coupled with the promise of intricate plotting and sharp character interactions, suggests a film that will satisfy those craving intelligent, adult-oriented entertainment. The presence of a strong ensemble cast further amplifies the anticipation, with viewers speculating about the roles each actor will play in Booth's latest escapades. This is precisely the kind of ambitious, character-driven project that WeCult readers live for – a deep dive into a beloved character with the promise of masterful filmmaking.

## What's Next

**The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth** is set to premiere in IMAX on November 25 for a limited two-week engagement, followed by its streaming release on Netflix on December 23. The teaser trailer is available now on Netflix's official YouTube channel, giving fans a substantial preview of the gritty, stylish world awaiting them.

content_raw: Picture Credit: Netflix The wait is finally over! After playing exclusively in movie theaters over the weekend in front of screenings of Resident Evil (well, for some anyway), Netflix has officially released the first teaser trailer for The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth online for the world to see ahead of its IMAX and Netflix release later this year.  We’ve been tracking this highly anticipated Once Upon a Time in Hollywood spin-off for months, and now we finally have our first real look at Brad Pitt’s return as the coolest (and deadliest) stuntman in cinematic history. Directed by David Fincher and penned by Quentin Tarantino, the movie looks to be an absolutely wild ride through 1977 Hollywood. If you haven’t watched the trailer yet, you can check it out on Netflix’s official YouTube channel now, and we’ve embedded it below. We’ve got first looks at nearly everyone here. From Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Emily Alyn Lind, Corey Fogelmanis. For those who want to read into every single word spoken in the rapid-fire teaser, we’ve transcribed the full trailer below. It gives us a great sense of the dark, Fincher-esque tone mixed with Tarantino’s trademark sharp dialogue, along with an epic track by Led Zeppelin – the 1971 hit, “Black Dog” .  We’ve also got an expanded new synopsis:  “Murder, blackmail, theft, extortion — just another summer in Hollywood. It’s 1977, eight years since Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt) encountered the Manson family in Quentin Tarantino’s parallel history of 1969, Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood. In THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH, directed by Fincher from a new script by Tarantino, the fairytale is over. Los Angeles no longer needs a hippie-slaying stuntman the way it did. But Hollywood will always have problems, problems that can only be solved by someone with Cliff’s unique (occasionally extralegal) abilities. When he’s not earning his keep bartending or as a projectionist, Cliff Booth is a fixer — solving situations for Hollywood’s greats and, sometimes, its not so good. He’s curious when he gets a call from talent agent Karen Crosby (Elizabeth Debicki), on behalf of her client, TV megastar Charlie Peters (Scott Caan) — a man known for doing his own stunts. And he’s further entertained and intrigued when he meets other characters in Charlie’s world, from his knowing wife Toni (Carla Gugino) to pro football champion turned screen star Roderick “Hot Rod” Harrison (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II). Then there are the Verdusco brothers (Matt Groove and JB Tadena), mysterious gangsters causing mayhem across the city.
